title: Homology compatibility of a localization factorization of restriction
statement: Let B₀→B be any homomorphism of commutative rings, U its exact restriction functor, E:D(B)→D(B₀) a functor between chosen derived categories, and q:S_B⋙E≅U_complex⋙S_B₀ a localization factorization, where S=π⋙Qh. For any integer i, let H,H₀ be derived homology and F,F₀ the composite derived/homotopy factorization isomorphisms from S⋙H to complex homology. There exists z:E⋙H₀≅H⋙U such that z_SK followed by U(F_K) equals H₀(q_K), then F₀_UK, then the exact-restriction short-complex homology isomorphism. No scalar extension, universal counit, ring equivalence, or tensor generator condition is assumed. Uses [def-weil-abstract-derived-category].

source.place: Section 13.11: localization and factorization of cohomology; exact restriction and the canonical short-complex homology comparison.

proof.text: Build the natural complex-homology isomorphism C from short-complex mapHomologyIso U; short-complex homology naturality proves its naturality. Compose H₀(q), F₀, C and U(F) inverse to get e between the localized homology functors.

S is a localization because π⋙Qh is naturally isomorphic to Q. Its whiskering functor is fully faithful. Take the fully faithful preimage isomorphism z of e; map_preimage gives its factorization equation. Cancel U(F) inverse followed by U(F) to obtain the displayed square.

theorem exists_derivedRestriction_homology_factors
    {B₀ B : Type u} [CommRing B₀] [CommRing B]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (ModuleCat.{u} B₀)]
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w'} (ModuleCat.{u} B)]
    (f : B₀ →+* B)
    (E : DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} B) ⥤ DerivedCategory (ModuleCat.{u} B₀))
    (i : ℤ) :
    let S₀ := HomotopyCategory.quotient (ModuleCat.{u} B₀) (.up ℤ) ⋙ DerivedCategory.Qh
    let S := HomotopyCategory.quotient (ModuleCat.{u} B) (.up ℤ) ⋙ DerivedCategory.Qh
    let U := restrictScalars.{u} f
    let H₀ := DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} B₀) i
    let H := DerivedCategory.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} B) i
    let F₀ := Functor.isoWhiskerLeft (HomotopyCategory.quotient _ (.up ℤ))
      (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctorFactorsh (ModuleCat.{u} B₀) i) ≪≫
      HomotopyCategory.homologyFunctorFactors (ModuleCat.{u} B₀) (.up ℤ) i
    let F := Functor.isoWhiskerLeft (HomotopyCategory.quotient _ (.up ℤ))
      (DerivedCategory.homologyFunctorFactorsh (ModuleCat.{u} B) i) ≪≫
      HomotopyCategory.homologyFunctorFactors (ModuleCat.{u} B) (.up ℤ) i
    ∀ q : S ⋙ E ≅ U.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ) ⋙ S₀,
      ∃ z : E ⋙ H₀ ≅ H ⋙ U,
        ∀ K : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} B) ℤ,
          z.hom.app (S.obj K) ≫ U.map (F.hom.app K) =
            H₀.map (q.hom.app K) ≫
              F₀.hom.app ((U.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj K) ≫
                ((K.sc i).mapHomologyIso U).hom
